Payments, mandates, allocation and reconciliation

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Trace a payment rail end to end
  • Apply exact allocation
  • Resolve breaks without duplicate posting

Technical flow

Every hand-off is a control boundary: on failure the flow holds, refers or denies — it never skips ahead.

  1. 01Mandate / instruction
  2. 02Rail initiation
  3. 03Signed status
  4. 04Settlement reconciliation
  5. 05Exact allocation
  6. 06Break or ledger post

1. Mandate and initiation

NACH, UPI, bank and other rails bind customer authority, account verification, limits, purpose, due item and idempotency before initiation or presentment.

2. Settlement before ledger

Signed provider events and settlement files reconcile to the expected instruction. Only an accepted, unmatched settlement posts once to the immutable loan ledger using the configured waterfall.

3. Break operations

Returns, chargebacks, suspense, value-date corrections and unmatched rows create attributed work with exact-paise reconciliation. Corrections use reversal and repost events, never destructive edits.
